job.job_description:
primary : Hands-on experience in building and deploying AI/ML models including Generative AI, LangChain and NLP, Python Programming, SQL experience



detailed JD:

Design, build, and optimize machine learning pipelines using Google Cloud Services.*Core Python Fundamentals*:OOPs concepts, Functions & Modules, Iterators / Generators,Exception handling, Decorators, Typing / Dataclasses,Data Structures & Algorithms,Design Patterns.*Machine Learning:*NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM,PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLflow, Matplotlib*Natural Language Processing (NLP & OCR)*:spaCy, NLTK, Transformers, Sentence-Transformers, Gensim, pytesseract, EasyOCR.*Generative & Agentic AI*:LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, FAISS / Pinecone,OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs, LangGraph Agents

More details on the requirement / Skills:

* Bachelors or higher degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or related field

* Hands-on experience in building and deploying AI/ML models including Generative AI, LangChain and NLP

* In-depth knowledge of machine learning algorithms, software architecture, libraries and frameworks to create AI that accomplishes outlined goals

* Rigorous knowledge of Python programming to develop software. Java is a plus.

* Skillful in developing and maintaining detailed, easy-to-read documentation including data dictionaries, model documentation, and code documentation

* Experience in integrating AI/ML into existing applications in batch and real-time

* Effective verbal and written communication skills to collaborate within and outside the team

* Ability to write and understand complex SQL(Hive/PySpark-dataframes) and optimize data pipelines. Experience with NoSQL is a plus

* Experience in Big Data ecosystem & Cloud technologies is nice to have

* Experience with GitHub and leveraging CI/CD pipelines

* Experience in taking models through AI/ML governance in highly regulated industry is a plus
